description: This header file defines the interface for an SNMP plugin in the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC). It declares external API functions such as initialization, support checks, unloading, and memory management, with C linkage for interoperability.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with the maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the SNMP plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Checks the memory usage or integrity.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Displays or manages the memory table status.
